name: django-markdownify
description: Django template filter that converts Markdown to sanitized HTML with configurable Markdown and sanitization settings.
agentsOsRelevance: Useful reference for keeping Markdown rendering and HTML sanitization separate from persistence. Its configurable rendering profiles are relevant to Atlas content tooling and to a future Django flat-file content pipeline, but it does not provide storage, model mapping, Git authority, or bidirectional synchronization.
